title: Standardised death rates by cause
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, three-year averages of age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

title: Standardised death rates by cause · 65 years or over
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection. Limited to 65 years or over.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, three-year averages of age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to 65 years or over.

caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A regional rate is a three-year average, so a single exceptional year is smoothed rather than visible.

title: Standardised death rates by cause · Males
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection. Limited to males.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, three-year averages of age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to males.

caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A regional rate is a three-year average, so a single exceptional year is smoothed rather than visible.

title: Standardised death rates by cause · Less than 65 years, Males
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection. Limited to less than 65 years, males.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, three-year averages of age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to less than 65 years, males.

title: Standardised death rates by cause · Less than 65 years, Females
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection. Limited to less than 65 years, females.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, three-year averages of age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to less than 65 years, females.

caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A regional rate is a three-year average, so a single exceptional year is smoothed rather than visible.

title: Standardised death rates by cause · 65 years or over, Females
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection. Limited to 65 years or over, females.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, three-year averages of age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to 65 years or over, females.

Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A regional rate is a three-year average, so a single exceptional year is smoothed rather than visible.
